name: zclass_object3d_render_traverse

known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the zDiRef union arm for range-fade blendScale still renders through the raw node field.
No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for object render traversal; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass render traversal source-cluster pass.
